routes.name: default

commonProbeRules.pattern: (?i)context (window|length) (exceeded|is full)|maximum context length|prompt is too long|exceeds? the context window
commonProbeRules.reason: the prompt does not fit the model context window

commonProbeRules.note: Before RATE_LIMIT: '429: quota exceeded' is the long wait, not the short one.

adapters.name: claude
adapters.note: The host CLI running these scripts: always available, so probeArgs is null (no probe runs). Its rules still classify the messages a launched claude session dies with. Its launch is code (BoardWork.Adapters.ps1), not a template: it sets up the auth variable first.

probeRules.pattern: (?i)usage limit reached|credit balance is too low|out of extra usage

probeRules.reason: not logged in (run /login or set the auth variable)
the prompt does not fit the model context window

adapters.name: antigravity
adapters.note: Replaces the retired 'gemini' adapter (#615). No npm package: Google ships an install script, which cannot be pinned (#765), so the user gets the page. Without the bypass agy soft-denies its own file-read headless, hence requiresBypass. It is told to READ the briefing: PowerShell drops embedded quotes when passing an argument to a native .exe.

probeRules.note: Google's retired-client answer arrives on exit 0 (#537, #615).
probeRules.reason: the provider retired this client (it can no longer authenticate)
refuses to run outside a trusted directory

args: Read the file {briefingFile} and follow its instructions to the letter.

adapters.name: jules
adapters.note: ASYNC cloud agent: 'jules new' dispatches a session on the REMOTE repo, not this worktree (phase-1 limitation). 'jules remote list' alone says 'Must specify what to list' on exit 0, so the probe scopes it with --session.

probeRules.pattern: (?i)jules login|not signed in|sign in to jules

probeRules.note: The session table header, BEFORE the shared phrases: a session titled 'fix the rate limit' must not read as a rate limit.

adapters.name: codex
adapters.note: 'codex login status' is a light auth check (~2.6 s, no stdin). 'codex exec' reads stdin even with a prompt argument, so the launch pipes $null into it (stdinNull).

probeRules.note: First, so the OK rule's 'Logged in' is never read inside 'Not logged in'.

adapters.name: copilot
adapters.note: The healthy footer says 'Total usage est: 1 Premium request', so 'premium request' alone is not a quota signal - only running out of them is.
